subject: 明代北方府城·马厩（原创扩展）

This is8x6metres, NEAR SQUARE in plan; do not stretch it to a long narrow shed. Exact template ground edges sloping+0.500/-0.500, do not move the four corners. The short side is75percent of the long side. Deep hard-gabled gray clay-tiled YINGSHAN roof with flush masonry gables and straight simple eaves, no curling tips. Fine realistic gray masonry, wood grain, small tile detail. Turn grid into natural stone paving seams, not drawn lines. Opaque realistic ancient sprite, upper-left daylight, short lower-right contact shadow. Thin flat rectangular platform, no raised pedestal, full roof and all ground corners intact. Transparent RGBA background withalpha0padding, no scenery, text, signs, modern things or people. The platform shape is a geometric invariant; fit architecture inside it, never resize platform.
